facts.fact: The DHIS2 project announced that the HISP network, selected by the Global Fund under its Climate x Health Catalytic Fund, will give technical assistance to seven African countries including Guinea-Bissau to integrate climate data into their existing national HMIS, using tools such as the DHIS2 Climate App; the announcement gives no start date, so its publication date is used, and it does not say which tools apply to Guinea-Bissau.

systems.platform: DHIS2 (implied by the DHIS2 Climate App; not stated for Guinea-Bissau individually)

systems.system: DHIS2 Climate App and Chap Modeling Platform
systems.owner: HISP UiO; Saudigitus (HISP Mozambique) among the supporting HISP groups
